day_5.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?

Honestly? I would have talked more. Like not about survival stuff, we did fine on that, but just actually talked. And I think I would have checked in on Michelangelo more, like actually checked in, not just told him to grab the bag and keep moving. Just to remind ourselves that we were still people out here and not just a resource log and a rationing plan. I think that's actually what kept DaVinci going when things got hard, like he needed to do something that wasn't just survival, something that was just him. And honestly? I think we all needed to see it even if we didn't say so. Some things don't have a practical purpose and that's exactly why they matter. Now come on, that boat is right there, get up off the ground.
